text:
A piece of aluminium is dropped into dilute hydrochloric acid.
No immediate reaction is observed.
Which statement explains this observation?
A
Aluminium does not neutralise acids.
B
Aluminium is a non-metal so does not react with acids.
C
Aluminium is below hydrogen in the reactivity series.
D
Aluminium is covered in an unreactive oxide layer.

options.label: B
options.text: Aluminium is a non-metal so does not react with acids.

options.label: C
options.text: Aluminium is below hydrogen in the reactivity series.

options.label: D
options.text: Aluminium is covered in an unreactive oxide layer.
